duplicate_groups.rationale: Both accepted observations concern the same collection-time HTTP 404 responses at /sitemap.xml and /pub/sitemap.xml, the robots.txt Sitemap directive naming /pub/sitemap.xml, REQ-015, and the identical three evidence IDs. The canonical checklist-mapped SEO finding already covers both endpoint URLs and retains the external diagnostic origin, its distinct original wording, severity, impact, uncertainty, recommendation, and independent evidence-review provenance in deduplication_trace.

merges_applied.preserved_review_provenance: The canonical's evidence-review object is retained; the merged origin's accepted status, independent_evidence_review provenance, reviewer ID and role, reviewed URL, reviewed requirement/evidence IDs, support result, reason, and supported fact are retained in deduplication_trace.

pattern_findings.evidence_supported_scope: The evidence index maps these eight desktop/mobile tracking-signal records to the homepage, one product detail page, one article, and the company page; each records gtm=0, ga4_requests_blocked=0, and data_layer_present=false.
pattern_findings.limits: This pattern is bounded to these four URL instances and collected sessions. The listed evidence does not cover category, search, or policy URLs; telemetry was blocked by the collector, and the records do not establish implementation absence, backend receipts, or conversion behavior.

pattern_findings.evidence_supported_scope: The accepted SEO observation reports a Default Description value on /sui-dovital and title-matching descriptions on the other two sampled priority product URLs.
pattern_findings.limits: Three sampled product URLs only; this does not establish sitewide prevalence or a shared implementation cause.

pattern_findings.evidence_supported_scope: Structured-data extracts report valid=0 and invalid=0 for desktop and mobile captures of the homepage and three sampled product URLs. The separate Glucare raw HTML evidence records Product microdata on that page.
pattern_findings.limits: This describes JSON-LD collector results on these sampled page instances only, not absence of every structured-data syntax or sitewide coverage. GEO-AEO-001 and STRUCTURED-DATA-001 remain separate because they differ in page coverage, requirement scope, and associated positive/alternate-format context; this pattern key does not merge or broaden either accepted claim.

non_merged_overlaps.rationale: SEO-002 includes the shared unavailable-sitemap evidence but also reports the distinct robots.txt Disallow: /*? rule and absence of named AI crawler groups, maps to REQ-011 as well as REQ-015, and has a different crawl-policy scope. Retain it separately from the canonical sitemap finding.

This candidate repeats the sitemap endpoint observations but evidence-decisions.json marks it rejected as duplicative and it has no accepted FND. It is not merged into or used to upgrade the accepted finding; its rejected status remains unchanged.

PERF-001 reports desktop and mobile LAB measurements; UXUI-001 interprets the same mobile measurement as a possible delay before the first viewport becomes useful. The measured property and the usability interpretation are distinct claim types. Retain both and do not count UXUI-001 as an independent performance sample.

The JSON-LD zero-detection claims overlap on the homepage and sampled product URLs, but STRUCTURED-DATA-001 covers a broader product URL set and REQ-010 plus REQ-010-01, while GEO-AEO-001 has the narrower REQ-010-01 scope and distinct article-page positive context. STRUCTURED-DATA-001 also explicitly records Product microdata in Glucare raw HTML. Keep both accepted findings and their original evidence/review records; do not infer absence of all structured data.
